seoDescription: Bridal Royal Zardosi blouse with gold Aari, pearl and red beads. Pair with red, maroon or gold silk sarees. Listed at ₹7,499; timing by enquiry.
seoCopy: Bridal Royal Zardosi is the most heavily embellished option in this collection, with dense gold-toned Aari-style embroidery, red bead details and pearl-like accents. The visible front image shows work around the neckline and sleeves; confirm the exact placement you want during the design discussion. The listing describes Zardosi-style embellishment alongside Aari-style stitching and beadwork, without specifying the precise metal or bead composition. Its warm gold and red palette can complement red, maroon, rust or traditional gold Kanchipuram silk; cream or deep green can also work when the saree border and jewellery repeat those tones. The listed starting price is ₹7,499 for embroidery on a customer-supplied blouse or garment. The garment itself, courier and material changes are quoted separately. This page does not promise a fixed production window: dense work may take longer, so share your event date, garment readiness and coverage preferences before accepting a quote. Khadeeja Designs will confirm the feasible crafting timeline after reviewing the brief and current studio workload; do not assume a date until it is agreed.
